name: Audio Selector
description: A powerful tool to route browser tab audio to any output device and manage your online meetings with ease.

select-audio-device.description: Change the audio output device for the current tab

meet-switch-tab.description: Switch to the next meet tab

meet-join.description: Join the meeting switch to it (if have only one meet tab)

meet-toggle-microphone.description: Mute/Unmute the microphone for the active meet tab (without switching)

meet-toggle-camera.description: Mute/Unmute the camera for the active meet tab (without switching)
